verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance is a B2B data/API platform (account verification, balances, transaction aggregation) consumed by other apps; there is no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced directly to an end user 'inside the product.' The 'Insights into transaction types/spending/recurring payments' item is a raw data categorization API output, not an AI-generated suggestion delivered within a user-facing product, and the MCP/agent toolkit evidence is about developers querying API documentation, not end-users getting insights from their own financial data.
